pr_json.title: feat(server): stream share downloads through the app
pr_json.body: Adds a /download endpoint that serves files from the share root by name.

diff:
diff --git a/download.py b/download.py
index 7f90ea1..47da12d 100644
--- a/download.py
+++ b/download.py
@@ -1,4 +1,6 @@
-from flask import Flask, request, send_from_directory
+import os
+
+from flask import Flask, request, send_file
 
 DATA_ROOT = "/srv/share"
 
@@ -7,4 +9,4 @@ app = Flask(__name__)
 @app.get("/download")
 def download():
     name = request.args.get("name", "")
-    return send_from_directory(DATA_ROOT, name)
+    return send_file(os.path.join(DATA_ROOT, name))
